newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - PaineWebber ups Gannett.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - PaineWebber ups Gannett.

text.p: -- PaineWebber said analyst William Drewry raised Gannett Co Inc to buy from attractive.
-- said newspaper revenues still gaining momentum and television trends much better than expected.
-- raised 1997 earnings estimate to $4.60 a share from $4.50, compared with $3.77 in 1996.
-- raised 1998 estimate to $5.15 a share from $5.05.
-- set target price of $104 on stock.
-- Gannett shares were up 3/4 to 82-3/4 in late morning trade.
